'''Island Four''' was an island on the [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]].

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWA-2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], including [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Kalifa/Legends|Kalifa]], [[O-Mer/Legends|O-Mer]], and [[Jinx/Legends|Jinx]], were captured and brought to Wasskah, where they were released to Island Four to be hunted by Trandoshans as a sport.<ref name="PL">{{TCW|Padawan Lost}}</ref>
